question: How many total medals were won by India at Tokyo Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seven.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won a total of **seven medals** at Tokyo Olympics 2020 (played in 2021).
 
• India won **one gold medal, two silver medals, and four bronze medals.**
 
• This is India's best performance at any Olympics so far, surpassing the previous record of six medals won at the **2012 London Olympics.**
 
• The** gold medal** was won by **Neeraj Chopra **in the** men's javelin throw event, **while the silver medals were won by **Mirabai Chanu** in weightlifting and **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** in wrestling.
 
• The four bronze medals were won by** Lovlina Borgohain** in boxing, **PV Sindhu **in badminton, **Bajrang Punia** in wrestling, and the men's hockey team. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India won** eight medals **at Tokyo Olympics 2020, but only seven of them were won by Indian athletes.
 
• The eighth medal was won by the Indian mixed team in shooting, which included one **Indian athlete and one Croatian athlete. **
